answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 16 identities per epoch. Audits are entered in grove, queued in thread, and summit publishes the wait time. A farm of 352 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3206 identities would post 4035 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
